name: TermChip
note: Baselines are regression references. A visual change re-writes them with --approve and needs critic approval (system rule).

critic.notes: Independent re-read of p0/a1/p50/p100 at full size and snap strip: four kinds distinct and legible, Arabic glosses correct RTL, palette clean, soft pool, no card edge. Held to 7 (not 8): chips are small (max ~15% of frame width), glow is faint, and motion (wipe, rim, 4 px settle) is not provable from settled stills; no strip exists. Non-blocking: request strip at anchor-2,0,+2,+4,+8,+16 at G8; host shot must supply depth/camera.
